column1: # One row = one single-stage optimization. Edit rows; "-" means driver default.
# Columns: TF_a  polarity  iota_target  current_limit_A  mpol  ntor  maxiter  step_radius  volume_target
# - TF_a selects the Stage-2 seed directory TF_a_X.XXX/ under STAGE2_ROOT.
# - current_limit_A is a SOFT threshold (zero objective cost below it), amperes.
# - mpol/ntor: Boozer solve Fourier orders; quadrature/certification densities
#   derive from them automatically. Runtime measured only at 6/6 (~minutes).
# - volume_target (m^3) overrides the fitted seed-boundary volume; "-" = seed.
